title: A/B experiments: guardrail evaluator + auto-rollback hook (latency/error regressions)
author: Allison Grant
body:
Title: Guardrail evaluator + auto-rollback hook for route-level A/B experiments

Context
This PR implements the first end-to-end guardrail loop for route-level A/B experiments: evaluate error/latency regressions on a running experiment, emit alerts, and (optionally) trigger the rollback workflow automatically. This is a dependency for beta enablement (ENG-2845 / ENG-2848) and addresses learnings from the EU-West capacity/429 incident class (see SUP-3940 for the customer-facing follow-up).

What’s in this PR
- Guardrail evaluator job (server-side, low-frequency) that evaluates experiment health on a fixed cadence using the aggregated results dataset (materialized views from ENG-2844).
- Guardrail rules v1:
  - Error-rate regression (5xx + gateway timeouts) vs control
  - 429-rate regression vs control (treated separately; often indicates capacity pressure)
  - p95 end-to-end latency regression vs control
  - p95 TTFT regression vs control (if streaming)
  - Minimum exposure gating to avoid acting on tiny samples
- Auto-rollback hook:
  - Calls Console/Control-plane rollback endpoint with (experiment_id, reason_code, evaluator_run_id)
  - Emits a structured “guardrail_triggered” event for alert routing + audit correlation
- Alerting integration:
  - Emits a guardrail evaluation summary event which is picked up by our alert router (existing infra used for rollout regressions)
  - Adds a default paging policy for “auto_rollback_executed” and a lower-severity warning for “guardrail_breached_no_action”
- Safety features / operational guardrails:
  - Dry-run mode (default ON in staging; OFF only via config in prod)
  - Cooldown window to prevent repeated rollbacks / alert spam
  - Sticky evaluator run IDs + idempotency key so retries don’t trigger multiple rollbacks
  - Region-aware evaluation (only evaluate where we have sufficient exposures; do not mix regions)
  - Hard cap on number of experiments evaluated per run to bound query costs

Design notes / behavior
- Comparisons are always against the experiment’s designated control variant (variant role = control). If no control role exists, evaluator refuses to act and emits a configuration error event.
- Evaluator uses a rolling window (default 10 minutes, configurable per tier) and requires min exposures per variant (default: 2k control / 500 treatment) before taking action.
- Regression math is intentionally simple for v1 (ratio + absolute delta threshold). We’re not doing statistical significance gating for operational rollback decisions.
- Rollback precedence: evaluator triggers the same rollback mechanism as Console “Rollback” so policy engine precedence stays consistent (no bypass).

Configuration (new)
- Added guardrail config under ab_testing.guardrails.* (tier-aware defaults). Example:
  - error_rate.max_relative_increase = 1.25
  - error_rate.max_absolute_increase = 0.002
  - latency_p95.max_relative_increase = 1.20
  - latency_p95.max_absolute_increase_ms = 150
  - http_429_rate.max_absolute_increase = 0.001
  - min_exposures.control = 2000
  - min_exposures.treatment = 500
  - cooldown_minutes = 30
  - action_mode = dry_run|auto_rollback

Code structure
- New package: services/ab_testing/guardrails
  - evaluator.ts (core orchestration)
  - rules/*.ts (metric-specific checks)
  - types.ts (shared contracts)
- New internal client: clients/rollouts/rollbackClient.ts (wraps rollback endpoint)
- New events: telemetry/events/ab_guardrail_evaluation_v1 + ab_guardrail_action_v1

Changed areas (high level)
- console-backend
  - Scheduled job registration + config wiring
  - Rollback client integration
- analytics/query layer
  - Read-only query helpers for aggregated experiment metrics
- alert router
  - New routing keys + templates for guardrail-triggered messages

Example log output
- "ab_guardrail_evaluation_v1": {experiment_id=exp_7f3..., region=eu-west-1, window=10m, breaches=["http_429_rate"], action_taken="auto_rollback"}

How tested
- Unit tests for each guardrail rule (boundary conditions: min exposures, NaNs, missing control)
- Integration test with a stubbed results dataset and mocked rollback endpoint
- E2E in staging:
  - Created an experiment on /v1/chat/completions with treatment forced to a throttled backend
  - Observed 429 breach => evaluator warning in dry-run
  - Switched action_mode to auto_rollback => rollback endpoint invoked once; subsequent runs suppressed by cooldown

Rollout plan
- Merge behind config defaults (dry_run in prod)
- Enable auto_rollback for internal dogfood projects only (feature-flag guarded)
- Expand to beta partners after SRE signoff + runbook verification

Checklist
- [x] Unit tests added
- [x] Idempotency + cooldown implemented
- [x] Alert templates reviewed with SRE
- [x] Config defaults documented
- [x] Linked to ENG-2845, ENG-2848

Screenshots
N/A (backend + alerting only).

Review conversation highlights
- Sean Gallagher: Requested cooldown + idempotency and explicit 429 handling (separate from generic error_rate). Also asked for a hard cap on evaluated experiments per run to avoid query storms.
  - Allison Grant: Added cooldown_minutes, evaluator_run_id, idempotency_key, and split 429-rate guardrail. Added max_experiments_per_run with pagination.
- Mina Haddad: Confirmed rollback call path uses the same policy rollback endpoint (no bespoke routing override). Requested region-isolated evaluation to avoid hiding a single-region incident.
  - Allison Grant: Evaluator now computes per-region breaches; does not aggregate across regions.
- Logan Wright: Requested that emitted events keep tag cardinality low (no route strings) and that experiment_id be the primary dimension.
  - Allison Grant: Events contain experiment_id + variant_id + region; route is intentionally omitted.
- Chloe Martin: Asked that missing-control-role be treated as a config error surfaced in the UI later.
  - Allison Grant: Added a “configuration_error” evaluation result and corresponding event type.

CI
- build (pass)
- unit-tests (pass)
- lint (pass)
- integration-tests (pass)

Merge
Merged via squash to main.

Follow-ups
- Add Console surface for guardrail configuration and action mode (tracked in ENG-2862)
- Improve evaluator to support per-metric alert throttling + dedupe across regions (ENG-2863)
- Add runbook links into alert payloads once runbook PR lands (ENG-2864)
commits: ab-testing/guardrails: add evaluator orchestration and rule engine
ab-testing/guardrails: add error-rate + 429-rate guardrails with min exposure gating
ab-testing/guardrails: add p95 latency + p95 TTFT regression checks
rollouts client: add rollback client + idempotency key support
telemetry: add guardrail evaluation/action events v1
alerts: route guardrail events and add templates + severity mapping
tests: unit + integration coverage for evaluator and rules
config: add tier-aware defaults + dry-run mode
release_notes: Adds backend guardrail evaluation for A/B experiments (latency/error/429 regressions) with optional auto-rollback and alerting hooks; defaults to dry-run in production until enabled by SRE.
